title: Existence of K-injective resolutions of sheaves of modules
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site whose underlying category is small (its objects form a set) and $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings on $\mathcal C$. Then the abelian category $\Mod(\mathcal O)$ of sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] is a Grothendieck abelian category [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian] (it has all colimits, filtered colimits are exact, and $\bigoplus_{U\in\operatorname{Ob}\mathcal C}j_{U!}\mathcal O_U$ is a generator), and every cochain complex $\mathcal M^\bullet$ of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] admits a K-injective resolution [def-pur-kinjective-complex] $\mathcal M^\bullet\to\mathcal I^\bullet$ which is injective in every degree, and which can be chosen functorially in $\mathcal M^\bullet$ (a functor $\mathcal M^\bullet\mapsto\mathcal I^\bullet$ on the category of complexes with a natural transformation from the identity whose components are such resolutions).

source.place: Section 07A5 (sites-cohomology-section-unbounded), first paragraph: Mod(O) is Grothendieck abelian (Modules on Sites, Section sites-modules-section-kernels, Lemmas sites-modules-lemma-j-shriek-flat, sites-modules-lemma-module-quotient-flat) and literature/stacks-project/injectives.tex Theorem 079P (injectives-theorem-K-injective-embedding-grothendieck)
